Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2009
ACT IV OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act further to amend
the laws relating to the Salaries
and Allowances of the Members of the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province
and Salaries, allowances and Privileges
of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the
North-West
Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
4th February, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP/Bills/2009/4050, dated
4-2-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 21st January, 2009 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 29th
January, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province (Salaries and Allowances of Members) Act, 1974 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.XI of 1974) and the North-West Frontier Province Speaker
and Deputy Speaker's, (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
(N.-W.F.P. Act No.III of 1975) for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges Laws (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
